title: Wall Mount Towel Ring 6-Inch Diameter Solid Brass, Foxtrot Collection | Glokzin Teal | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Towel Ring 6-Inch Diameter | Allied Brass, Glokzin Teal
description:
Add convenient towel storage with a wall mount towel ring crafted from solid brass and sized at 6-inch diameter for everyday hand towels in Glokzin Teal, which delivers rich, jewel-toned sophistication, adding artistic depth and a designer touch to modern bathrooms. Part of the Foxtrot collection, this round ring complements transitional bathroom hardware and helps keep towels within easy reach while saving space.

Highlights:
- Glokzin Teal transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting for a clean, streamlined look
- Includes towel ring and all installation hardware
- Coordinates with other versatile bath accessories in the Foxtrot collection

Specs:
- Product type: Towel ring (round)
- Diameter: 6 inches
- Projection: 2 inches
- Overall size (L x W x H): 6 x 6 x 6 inches
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Product weight: 1.6 lb
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
